title: Working in the houserules kit repository

entries.summary: Edit the kit in `template/`, then run `node bin/houserules.mjs update --dir .`; never hand-edit the root copies or the generated rules and skill.
body: This repository runs its own kit. The root `tools/`, `.claude/agents/`, `.claude/skills/orchestrating`, and `.claude/skills/finishing-a-feature` are the installed copy; `template/` is the source that `init` and `update` ship to every project.
`tests/dogfood.test.mjs` pins every root copy to its template source byte for byte; a hand edit fails the test and is lost on the next update.
`.claude/rules/*.md` and `.claude/skills/project-knowledge/SKILL.md` are generated by `tools/kb.sh render` from `knowledge/`.

entries.summary: Treat `~/projects/tag-pilot` as a read-only reference: never modify it, commit there, run its agents, or run `init` or `update` against it.
body: tag-pilot (branch `knowledge-management`, PR #42) is the origin of this kit and, until the adoption ruling in docs/design.md §5.4, the upstream of every kit-owned file.
Before every release, diff its `tools/`, `.claude/agents/`, and `.claude/skills/` against `template/` and port the drift; the first port is `process.evals-rerun` with its `co-change` check (HR-003).

entries.summary: Live-run every CLI change in a scratch `git init` repo: `init --dir <scratch>`, both checks inside the scratch; each gate is its own report entry with `exit`.
body: Scratch repositories live under the session scratchpad, never inside this repository and never in tag-pilot. Run `tools/kb.sh check` and `tools/backlog.sh check` there and record each command’s verbatim output as its own report tests entry (batch 3 task 3 recorded only one of a chained pair).

`pnpm dlx git+file://<this clone> files` exercises the published path (pnpm's bin shim execs the real file); `node <scratch>/node_modules/houserules/bin/houserules.mjs files` after `pnpm add --save-exact git+file://<this clone>` exercises the symlinked path (HR-001).
For a change to `update`, run `init` and then `update` in the same scratch repository and confirm that only kit-owned files changed.
The report names the scratch path (a `cd` entry or the path in the command) and records the init and both check gates as their own entries; a live run without them fails the recipe.

entries.summary: `node` and `pnpm` are on PATH only under `mise exec --` or `mise run` (`mise exec -- pnpm test`); without `mise.toml`, mise resolves no tools.
body: For a scratch directory, run tools as `mise x node@24.18.1 pnpm@11.18.0 -- <command>`; mise strips the paths of inactive tools, so a PATH export does not survive `mise x`.
The shipped wrappers `tools/kb.sh` and `tools/backlog.sh` use `node` from PATH and fall back to `mise exec node` on their own.

source.ref: session of 2026-08-31: mise could not exec npm in a scratch directory; probe of 2026-09-01

entries.summary: Relative to tag-pilot: unprefixed agent and skill names, `project-knowledge` skill, `dependency_vetting` for field `a19`, parameterized id prefix.
body: Agents: `tagpilot-implementer` → `implementer`, `tagpilot-task-reviewer` → `task-reviewer`, `tagpilot-branch-reviewer` → `branch-reviewer`. Skills: `tagpilot-orchestrating` → `orchestrating`, `tagpilot-knowledge` → `project-knowledge`.
Backlog ids: `TP-` → `--id-prefix` (default `WI`, `HR` in this repository). The install stamp is `.houserules.json`.
The kit was named lorekit until 2026-08-31; docs/design.md §5.1 records the rename.

entries.summary: The payload in `template/` runs on Node built-ins and POSIX shell only: no dependency, no build step; the CLIs work in a fresh clone before any install.
body: The SessionStart hook and the CI gates run where nothing is installed; a runtime dependency would break both (docs/design.md §2, option B).
This repository's devDependencies (vitest, commitlint) serve its own tests and commit hook only and never enter `template/`.

entries.summary: Use pnpm for every package operation in this repository (`pnpm install`, `pnpm add --save-exact`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm dlx`); never `npm` or `npx`.
body: Owner ruling of 2026-09-01. The workspace follows tag-pilot: exact `node` and `pnpm` pins in `mise.toml`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` as the only lockfile, the mise tasks `setup`, `test`, `lint`, and `audit`.
The payload in `template/` has no dependency and no install step (`houserules.payload-runs-on-builtins`); the ruling changes nothing there.

entries.summary: Vitest `restoreMocks` restores `vi.spyOn` spies only; reset a `vi.mock` factory’s `vi.fn` in an explicit `afterEach` with `mockReset()`.
body: `mockReset()` on a mock made with `vi.fn(impl)` also restores `impl` and drops queued `mockImplementationOnce` entries, so the wrapped real function comes back (verified against the Vitest 4 docs in the batch 3 task 1 fix round).
`tests/init.test.mjs` (the `vi.mock` factory for node:child_process and its `afterEach`) is the in-repo example.

source.ref: batch 3 task 1 review, critical 2; task-1-report.json docs_verified

entries.summary: When `KIT_OWNED` gains or loses a path, update README's agent-layer bullet and ownership table in the same commit.
body: README.md enumerates the kit-owned skills twice: the agent-layer bullet and the ownership-manifest table.
No test pins these enumerations; batch 5's task 1 review caught both stale after KIT_OWNED grew. A co-change check would misfire (bin changes without README constantly), so the rule stays judged.
